findings.decompiled: mem[_1321 + ceil32(return_data.size)] = 1 == stor656D / mem[_1321 + ceil32(return_data.size) + 32] = 0 / log ProfitsNotCollected(bool sell, bool floor): mem[mem[64] len _1321 + ceil32(return_data.size) - mem[64] + 64]
findings.source: AaveFoldStrategy.sol:261-264 if (!sell()) { emit ProfitsNotCollected(sell(), false); return; }
findings.issue: The event's two data words are written just before the log, but the log reads them as a raw memory range from mem[64] whose length still contains mem[64], so the reader cannot see 'ProfitsNotCollected(sell(), false)'. This is the P2 cause (mem[64] = _1321 + ceil32(return_data.size) was written a few lines above) applied to a log instead of a call.
findings.rule: Fold mem[64] to the last value stored to it on every path (here _1321 + ceil32(return_data.size)); then a log of mem[p len 64] whose words were just stored prints its arguments.

findings.source: BaseUpgradeableStrategyStorage.sol:119-124 for (uint i = 0; i < _list.length; i++) if (_list[i] == _searchValue) return true; return false; :282-284 for (...) values[i] = getAddress(bytes32(uint(slot) + 1 + i));

findings.rule: 'while True: if c: S_exit' is 'while not c:' followed by S_exit; drop 'if i >= n: revert' inside a loop guarded by i < n (n unchanged in the body); x[p + 12 len 20] of a word is address(mem[p]).

findings.rule: concat(Bytes(12, 0), x[12 len 20]) of a word is address(x); a require implied by the next require (x == 0 implies x < 4) is dropped.

findings.source: Initializable.initializer: require(_initializing || !_initialized); if (isTopLevelCall) { _initializing = true; _initialized = true; } _; if (isTopLevelCall) _initializing = false;
findings.issue: The two packed bools of slot 0 are one uint16 stor0 read as stor0 / 256 and uint8(stor0) and written as 257 and as stor0.field_8 (P15); in the else arm _2 = stor0 / 256 is known to be 0, so _4 is just 1.
findings.rule: Split a slot into the fields its accesses use (bytes 0 and 1 here); in the arm where 'if x' failed, x is 0, so 'not x' folds to 1 and the if/else becomes '_4 = not (stor0 / 256)'.

notes: All 61 ABI functions reviewed: the getters, setters, governance checks, scheduleUpgrade/finalizeUpgrade, initialize*, receiveFlashLoan read and matched; emergencyExit (774 lines), withdrawAllToVault (2403), withdrawToVault (2623) and doHardWork (3002) reviewed by structure (loops, calls, events, storage writes). Loops: getAddressArray (isRewardToken, rewardTokens), _isAddressInList, _liquidateReward's reward-token loop ('while s < rewardTokens.length'), _depositNoFlash ('while w < s') and _redeemNoFlash ('while u > 0' with newBorrowTarget folded to 0 in emergencyExit/withdrawAllToVault, 'while v > s' elsewhere) are all whiles, with inlined copies. The 21 'while idx < _N: mem[t] = Bytes(12, 0), mem[s + 12 len 20]' / 'mem[s] = mem[t]' blocks are the ABI encoding of address[]/uint256[] memory arrays (P7); receiveFlashLoan's 'while idx < _param1 + 32 * _param1.length + 36' is the validated ABI decode of IERC20[] (implicit, readable). P2 also hides most Aave pool calls inside the loops (POOL(), withdraw, repay as raw memory); P6 is mostly Error(string) (127) plus 0x03140ff4/0x06974e8d selectors and one storage slot of def storage. receiveFlashLoan reads amounts[0]/feeAmounts[0] as memory slices of their calldata copies (P14). Event names of the ABI (ProfitLogInReward, PlatformFeeLogInReward, StrategistFeeLogInReward) are not in the signature database (normal).
summary: Faithful and its loops are all found; readability suffers mainly from P2 (411 lines, including an event whose data is raw memory), the ABI-encoding loops left as whiles, and Initializable's packed slot handled as one uint16.
